title: The shell-write scan with `writes_first` is quadratic: a 6500-word command times out and runs unjudged
why: A long command that the guard cannot judge in time runs with no verdict, so the guard allows what it could not read.
source: Lane rebuild-2123 (session_013NEJL4Lqx759D54GPKCSc2) 14:44 CST Nov 13: PR #3249 (replaces #2123) passed review; notes are in the review-record comment "Notes, none blocking". Lane says worth a debt.
